mine_news.headline: Should fantasy hoops managers expect a return to dominance from Nikola Jokic?
mine_news.body: Nikola Jokic's numbers are down from his typical norm, but has he been passed by Wemby or Luka as the top player in fantasy?

mine_news.headline: Ty Jerome: Probable for Saturday
mine_news.body: Jerome (hip) is probable for Saturday's game in Minnesota.

mine_news.headline: Caleb Wilson's hand injuries not connected as Bulls rookie deals with 'bad luck'
mine_news.body: Caleb Wilson has sustained three hand-related injuries in the past year, but the Chicago Bulls rookie said doctors told him they're no connected, and that it's a case of "bad luck," he told reporters before his club's game against the Washington Wizards.

mine_news.headline: Austin Reaves: Expected to return Monday or Friday
mine_news.body: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Reaves (heel) to return for Monday's matchup with Utah or Friday's game in San Antonio, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

mine_news.headline: Dyson Daniels: Flirts with triple-double Friday
mine_news.body: Daniels posted 11 points (5-10 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 10 assists, eight rebounds and four steals over 35 minutes during the Hawks' 111-97 win over the Hornets on Friday.

mine_news.headline: Kyshawn George: Struggles from field in win
mine_news.body: George posted 11 points (5-17 FG, 1-8 3Pt), seven rebounds, five assists, two blocks and one steal across 35 minutes during Friday's 98-94 victory over Chicago.
